semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides specialized heating elements and industrial furnaces, which are critical for processes like annealing and thermal processing in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Riken Heat Techno Co., Ltd. manufactures electric heating elements and industrial furnaces, offering products such as the Pyromax metal heating element and ceramic heating elements for a wide temperature range. They provide solutions for thermal processing needs in semiconductor manufacturing, including stage heaters and aluminum block magnet heaters.
